main_sample.definition: the floor of sample #1 (comfort:0.5 x streaming_universal default processing, the v01 run) with the direction dir_cf3e85c484fa applied on top (direction apply -> master plan -> render -> verify -> gate -> direction check against the floor)

direction.request: 空間音響 × 複雑で心地の良いパンニング（公式サンプルの主サンプル。主張は測定可能な形で、床との差を指揮の分として説明できるように。主役の明瞭さと配信出口の健全さは崩さない）
direction.document: private (D-068: case records stay in the local kb); id and outcome are published

main_sample.delta_note: the direction does not change the cleanup; the delta of the main sample is byte-identical to the floor's (stem_sum_delta sha256 bfb67ac4...)

known_issue.en: direction check ignored the band [300, 5000] of the mono_loss observation and measured the full band (same value as c17). An independent FFT measurement of the 300-5000 Hz band gives a mono loss of 0.1390 dB (floor) and 0.1388 dB (main).
